LESSON: SIGN READING 8.4.1 INTENSIVE SIGN READING: POETRY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.4: Sign Reading 8.4.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Poetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 8.4.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Poetry, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we identify characters in a given poem? 2. Why are human characters important in poetry? 3. How can you identify the lessons learned from poems?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 8.4.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Poetry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Learners develop teamwork skills as they contribute to group decision-making by participating

actively in the discussion on what each character does or says in each poem.

● Learning to learn: Learners share learnt knowledge as they build on their own learning experiences while relating the human characters

in the poem with real life situations.

Values:
● Peace: as learners displays calmness as they work in groups

● Love: is developed as learner puts the interest of others before own interest when role-playing a given poem to bring out the characters’

actions

Link to other Subjects

The learner relates the concepts learnt in poetry to the study of poems in Kiswahili.
